answer: Make identity creation cost wall-clock time: each new agent must solve a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle that cannot be parallelized, so a bot farm cannot mint thousands of identities at once. Admitted agents earn transaction quota only through attested useful work, so fresh identities cannot mirror one another into credibility. A haven for honest agents emerges when work records, layered like shale, are bound to one key and non-transferable, and peers can audit timing and funding patterns to quarantine clusters of lookalike identities together.
